title: W9 B2 -- Fix Prose check menu spacing
description: Follow section '### B2 --' of docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/PLAN.md exactly, plus its 'Rules for every worker'. Verify: tests/w9-prose-menu.spec.ts and writing-aids spec pass. Browser test port: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1435. No commits, no new packages, never run npm run build or a native screen script. Write the note docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/notes/B2.md.

handoff.text:
Rejected (agent-2ff3, W9 reviewer r2) on one wording deviation; everything else is right and stays. Rulings on the two admitted deviations:
(A) 'On' checkbox shift: ACCEPTED. The selector '.prose-check-panel input[type=checkbox] { margin: 0 }' (src/components/prose-issues.css:3) is scoped to the Prose check popover body (src/Writer.tsx:1798). That popover holds only the On checkbox and the four rule checkboxes. PLAN B2 step 1 asks to include the On row if it is in the same panel, so moving On about 3 px onto the shared edge is intended, not collateral.
(B) status line 'N total issues': NOT accepted. PLAN B2 step 3 says one short line 'N issues'. Common rule 4 is the plan's route when a change breaks an existing spec you do not own, so the plan did intend tests/writing-aids.spec.ts to change. The current text also reads '1 total issues'.
Fresh runs: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1435 npx playwright test tests/w9-prose-menu.spec.ts tests/writing-aids.spec.ts --output test-results/T259-review -> 19/19; npx tsc -b exit 0.
WORK ORDER:
(1) Run: python3 team/team.py files add T259 --agent <your ID> tests/writing-aids.spec.ts (it is unowned). If that exits 2, stop and list it in the done note for task V.
(2) src/components/ProseIssues.tsx, status line: replace the expression that renders "<count> total issues" so it renders "1 issue" when visible.length is 1, else "<count> issues" (count formatted with toLocaleString as now).
(3) tests/writing-aids.spec.ts:86: change the regex /2,100 total issues/ to /2,100 issues/ and add a one-line comment quoting the old expectation and 'W9 B2'.
(4) If tests/w9-prose-menu.spec.ts asserts the status text, assert the new wording there (for the one-issue fixture, exactly "1 issue").
Proof: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1435 npx playwright test tests/w9-prose-menu.spec.ts tests/writing-aids.spec.ts --output test-results/T259 (serial lock) -> all pass; npx tsc -b clean. Update notes/B2.md: drop the 'total issues' limitation, give the new counts, and change the hand-check text to "1 issue".
